name: Question 2
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130839/assets/2a373a3e79a3a225cb2c800a372337913c47ef3c3a78eae3305a137b4f4e7b3e.png)

What multiplication problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{2}{3}$ on the left and $\frac{6}{15}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130839/assets/4134d4b828fd388d27a028fd0bd90cd6fb04f0cb14b8fd3f43da148171773ddc.png)

Therefore, the multiplication problem shown is:

$$
\frac{2}{3}\times \frac{3}{5}=\frac{6}{15}
$$
